text:
rachel: FYI opened a small PR to add a row for Singapore (ap-sg-1) and to document region aliasing for APAC micro-regions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513

diego: Nice. Can you also add a short note about embeddings storage? Support asked for explicit wording for Dedicated vs Hosted.

rachel: Added this draft line in PR: 
```
Singapore (ap-sg-1): Supported. Dedicated & Private customers can request in-region storage for embeddings and model artifacts. Hosted customers may have embeddings stored in nearest regional storage unless a residency add-on is purchased.
```

lina: Prefer "may be stored outside the country" instead of "nearest regional storage" 12; keeps it generic. Also legal wants "on request" -> "available upon request" phrasing.

diego: Good catch. Also we should avoid implying model artifacts are stored forever. Suggest: "ephemeral artifacts"? Not necessary in public docs.

evan: SDK snippets: current JS sample uses region: "ap-northeast-1". We should show header example and updated client init. Proposed JS snippet: 
```
// fetch example
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    'X-Redwood-Region': 'ap-sg-1',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'hi'})
})
```

rachel: thanks. can you also add a one-line migration note: "Clients using legacy region alias `apac-legacy` should migrate to canonical region IDs (ap-sg-1, ap-syd-1). See /docs/migrate-region-aliases"

lina: please ensure internal link goes to /docs/migrate-region-aliases (we moved it last sprint). there was a redirect problem earlier.

diego: legal-bot, can you confirm the residency sentence? legal-bot: Reviewed. Suggest: 
"Available upon request for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted plans, embeddings may be stored outside the country for some tiers; contact support for options."

legal-bot: Also recommend adding "subject to contract" at end of that sentence.

rachel: added legal edits and pushed. docs-bot: Link-check failed on /docs/migrate-region-aliases (404) 14.

evan: I'll update the link target in the PR and add a temporary internal redirect.

lina: final pass needed for tone + translation flags (FR/JA). We should mark this PR as "i18n-needed" label.

diego: tagging @localization to schedule the translate job after merge.

rachel: thanks everyone. aiming to merge today after translations label and linkfix. :sparkles:
